title: Typed put and get round-trip a value through the KV driver realising the Workers KV binding shape
asA: developer using the facade behind an app request handler
iWant: facade.put(key, value) then facade.get(key) to return the same bytes, with paired kvWrite and kvHit events
soThat: a request handler can persist and read state deterministically through one seam

acceptanceCriteria.description: facade.put(key, value) writes a value; facade.get(key) returns the same bytes; both operations emit their paired lifecycle events (kvWrite on put, kvHit on get). The round-trip works against the in-memory KV driver in the cf-platform fixture (src/kv-driver.mjs) whose binding shape matches the real Workers KV binding contract per https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/api/.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade wired to the in-memory KV driver in the cf-platform fixture
acceptanceCriteria.when: the facade-round-trip probe puts a fixture key/value and reads it back
acceptanceCriteria.then: the read returns the same bytes; the event sink records one kvWrite and one kvHit; the probe report aggregates to pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: facade.delete(key) removes a value; a subsequent facade.get(key) returns null and emits kvMiss.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a key previously put via the facade
acceptanceCriteria.then: the delete emits kvWrite; the get returns null and emits kvMiss
